name: PIR motion sensor (HC-SR501)
description: Passive infrared motion detector: OUT goes HIGH (3.3 V) when a person moves within ~5 m and stays HIGH for the delay time (prop delay_s, the Tx knob), then ignores motion for ~2.5 s. VCC → 5V (4.5 to 20 V; it has its own 3.3 V regulator), GND → GND, OUT → a digital pin with digitalRead. Simulate motion with press / release or set_sensor_value(part, "motion", 1).

pins.label: VCC
pins.description: 4.5 to 20 V. Not 3.3 V: the on-board regulator needs ≥ 4.5 V.

pins.label: OUT
pins.description: HIGH (3.3 V) while motion is reported, LOW otherwise. Safe for 3.3 V and 5 V boards.

props.label: Hold time (Tx knob)
props.description: How long OUT stays HIGH after motion. Knob fully anticlockwise ≈ 3 s, clockwise ≈ 300 s.

props.label: Trigger mode (jumper)

options.label: Single (L): one fixed pulse per trigger

props.description: Jumper H restarts the hold time on every movement; L gives one pulse, then a new one if motion is still there after the block time.

props.label: Warm-up time
props.description: Time after power-up during which motion is ignored. Real modules need 30–60 s (and may trigger falsely meanwhile); 0 keeps tests fast.

footprint: HC-SR501 module, 32 × 24 mm, 23 mm Fresnel dome, 3-pin 0.1 in header (VCC OUT GND)

bindings.description: Something is moving in front of it (the simulated input).
Times OUT went HIGH since reset.
"idle", "motion" (OUT high), "blocked" (2.5 s after OUT fell), "warming up" or "off".
Opacity of the dome glow (1 while OUT is HIGH).
